<music-staff id="trombone-study" label="Trombone" clef="bass" measure-numbers="none" print-width="940" justify-last="">
  <music-measure id="trombone-m1">
    <music-meter id="trombone-meter-1" top="4" bottom="4"></music-meter>
    <music-note id="trombone-m1-n1" pitch="G2" duration="quarter"></music-note>
    <music-note id="trombone-m1-n2" pitch="G2" duration="quarter"></music-note>
    <music-note id="trombone-m1-n3" pitch="G2" duration="quarter"></music-note>
    <music-rest id="trombone-m1-r1" duration="quarter"></music-rest>
  </music-measure>
  <music-measure id="trombone-m2">
    <music-meter id="trombone-meter-2" top="3" bottom="4"></music-meter>
    <music-note id="trombone-m2-n1" pitch="C3" duration="16th" beam="start"></music-note>
    <music-note id="trombone-m2-n2" pitch="Ab2" duration="eighth" dots="1" beam="end"></music-note>
    <music-note id="trombone-m2-n3" pitch="E3" duration="quarter"></music-note>
    <music-rest id="trombone-m2-r1" duration="quarter"></music-rest>
  </music-measure>
  <music-measure id="trombone-m3" end-bar="final">
    <music-meter id="trombone-meter-3" top="4" bottom="4"></music-meter>
    <music-note id="trombone-m3-n1" pitch="Eb3" duration="16th" beam="start"></music-note>
    <music-note id="trombone-m3-n2" pitch="D3" duration="16th" beam="continue"></music-note>
    <music-note id="trombone-m3-n3" pitch="A2" duration="16th" beam="continue"></music-note>
    <music-note id="trombone-m3-n4" pitch="B2" duration="16th" beam="end"></music-note>
    <music-rest id="trombone-m3-r1" duration="quarter"></music-rest>
    <music-rest id="trombone-m3-r2" duration="16th"></music-rest>
    <music-note id="trombone-m3-n5" pitch="F3" duration="16th" beam="start"></music-note>
    <music-note id="trombone-m3-n6" pitch="C#3" duration="16th" beam="continue"></music-note>
    <music-note id="trombone-m3-n7" pitch="Bb2" duration="16th" beam="end"></music-note>
    <music-note id="trombone-m3-n8" pitch="Gb2" duration="quarter"></music-note>
  </music-measure>
</music-staff>
